options.text: Choose a new answer without explaining what changed.
Keep the core method for 文化與習俗, but revise the language or evidence affected by the changed detail in this transfer task.
Keep every word and ignore the changed detail.
Remove the evidence so the answer cannot be checked.

answer.explanation: Transfer preserves the lesson relationship while responding to the new condition; the relevant anchor is 本課把文化理解放進英文溝通：學生從兩張自編活動卡讀出人物、時間、地點與行動，再以比較句、限定.。正確答案為選項 B：「Keep the core method for 文化與習俗, but revise the language or evidence affected by the changed detail in this transfer task.」。最後把這個選項放回題幹，確認它同時符合題目條件與本單元判準。
